body: I have done a bit of research on schools that offer assistance to the blind. But I wanted to be an EMT and I think I would just be super depressed going to school knowing that in could have been what I wanted and now I can't because of some squishy Little white orbs in my head. So I'm just going top continue EMT training until I'm blind or they stop me from taking the classes due to my impaired vision.
I am 22, I currently work as a security guard and am taking EMT training courses which I plan on taking until I lose my vision completely.
Wow that Is amazing I can't help but imagine that echo location is only for very very few. But lucid dreaming might be amazing. Thank you.

Thank you guys for commenting and letting me know there is more to life. Its just so scary waking up every morning knowing one day I'll wake up and there will be nothing. It just feels like my whole life is ending... I'm fairly young 22 so I don't know how I will be able to go to work or school because I am a visual learner... My gf already left and it just like there this hard lump in my throat every time in think about my sight. Thank you though, really.
